title: An invite-only viewer lands on /new/ with the normal first screen and the Inbox open beside it: the invite card body is inert, Accept goes into the site; mail names a person by the local part
steps: Common setup (tests/regression/README.md § Common setup): ORIGIN (= O), COOKIE_DOMAIN, A, seat A's cookie COOKIE_A, api. Case variables: KEY = a site where seat A is Owner; C = a fresh address reg057-<unix seconds>@example.test.
Invite: api a POST /api/team/invite '{"role":"editor","emails":["<C>"],"siteKeys":["<KEY>"]}' -> record NOTIFIED = results[0].notified.
Mint C's cookie the way Common setup mints A's (mintSession with the stand's SESSION_SECRET; never print it) -> COOKIE_C.
Root door: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}' -H 'Accept: text/html' -H "Cookie: tracy_sess=$COOKIE_C" $O/ -> record ROOT.

Browser: a NEW Playwright context {locale:'en-US', viewport:{width:1400,height:900}} with cookie tracy_sess = COOKIE_C. page.goto(O + '/'); wait (<= 90 s) for .tracy-inbox .tracy-inbox-row.is-card containing KEY. Record URL0 = page.url(), GREETING = count of .tv-start-title, WHOAMI = count of .tracy-inbox-whoami, ATTR = document.documentElement.hasAttribute('data-tracy-pending-invites'), CARD_ROLE = the role attribute of that card.
Click the card's .tracy-inbox-name, wait 1.5 s -> URL1 = page.url(). Then click the card's Accept button and wait (<= 60 s) for the URL to contain '/' + KEY + '/' -> URL2.
Clean up: api a GET /api/team -> in sites[] the entry whose siteKey is KEY, its seats[] row whose email is C -> its id; api a DELETE /api/sites/<KEY>/seats/<id> -> record CLEANUP = the status.
expect: The unit seams exit 0 with '# fail 0'.

URL0 path starts with '/new/' (dsh then writes the session into the path) and its query has tab=tracy:inbox; GREETING === 1 (the normal first screen, decided 04/10 after #863); WHOAMI === 0; ATTR === false; CARD_ROLE === null.
URL1 === URL0 (pressing the invite card's body does nothing).

selectors.doors: GET / (302 to /new/?tab=tracy:inbox when only invitations wait) · POST /api/team/invite · POST /api/sites/:key/accept

evidence: On cowork.tracy.site 04/10: an invite-only sign-in landed on the 'An invitation is waiting' page with nothing to press but join links; pressing an invite card's body opened Team ('Could not read this site's team') and marked it read unanswered; the invite mail's title was a raw address Gmail turned into a link.
fence: workspace/route.js redirects a signed-in viewer with no accepted seat and a pending invitation to /new/?tab=tracy:inbox, where the creation workspace shows its normal first screen beside the Inbox; pressableIn() leaves an open invitation's body inert; Accept marks the row read and lands in the site; shortName/personLine name a person by the local part when no display name exists.
